title: Air-Gapped & VPC Inference Deployments
tagline: Policy checks that keep an LLM deployment inside a private VPC: internal digest-pinned images, default-deny networking, no public egress, no public IPs.
why: Banks, hospitals and government buyers will not send data to a public API. The model has to run inside their VPC or on a network with no internet at all. The hard part is not starting the container; it is proving to their security team that nothing can leak out. This repo turns that proof into checks that run before every deploy: the same rules on the Kubernetes manifests, the Terraform plan and the egress firewall.
covers: Kubernetes lint: internal registry, @sha256 pinning, default-deny NetworkPolicy, no 0.0.0.0/0 egress, internal-only load balancers, hardened pods, GPU limits and node pools
Egress allow-list engine: strict IPv4/CIDR math, wildcard host rules, deny by default, refuses an allow-all rule
Terraform plan scan: IGW, NAT, public IPs, open security groups, S3 public access, public EKS endpoint, mutable ECR tags
Image mirror plan: skopeo commands that copy public images into the internal registry by digest
Reference Terraform module (private VPC + VPC endpoints) and Helm chart (offline vLLM server) in infra/
gaps: The Terraform and Helm in infra/ are reference code; they were not applied to a real AWS account from this repo
No on-prem GPU provisioning (drivers, MIG, bare-metal) and no service mesh / mTLS zero-trust layer
YAML input: render with helm template and convert to JSON first (helm template . | yq -o json); only IPv4 CIDRs
extra_md:
## Reference infrastructure

`infra/terraform/main.tf` builds a VPC with private subnets only, no internet or NAT gateway, VPC endpoints for ECR, STS, CloudWatch Logs and S3, and an immutable ECR repository. `infra/helm/private-llm/` runs an OpenAI-compatible vLLM server with `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`, a default-deny NetworkPolicy, a read-only root filesystem and a GPU node selector.

Check them with this repo before you apply:

```bash
terraform plan -out plan.out && terraform show -json plan.out > plan.json
python3 -c 'import json;print(json.dumps({"plan":json.load(open("plan.json"))}))' | cargo run -q -- scan_tf_plan
```

ops.label: Lint a risky deploy
ops.help: A typical first draft: public image, tag not digest, no default-deny policy, GPU request without a limit, public load balancer. Every high finding blocks the deploy.

ops.label: Lint the fixed deploy
ops.help: The same service after the fixes. pass is true: no high findings.

ops.label: Egress firewall
ops.help: Deny by default. Only the VPC range and the S3 endpoint on 443 are open. Try adding a rule with cidr 0.0.0.0/0: it is refused.

ops.label: Terraform plan scan
ops.help: Excerpt of terraform show -json. The plan adds an internet gateway, a public subnet, an open security group and a public EKS endpoint.

ops.label: Mirror images
ops.help: Plan the copy of public images into the internal registry. Tag-only images are flagged: resolve the digest before the air gap.
